operator_decisions.crash_harness: exhaustive campaign at freeze certification; quick representative recovery subset in normal tests
operator_decisions.drafts: tools/g_route3_store.py and tools/g_route3_runner_new.py stay untracked and unwired until acceptance
operator_decisions.journal: one append-only journal per run is authoritative; other artifacts are projections
operator_decisions.review: design review now (Reviewer A: journal/replay correctness and recoverability; Reviewer B: scientific integrity and authorization/attempt semantics); implementation review later by fresh reviewers
operator_decisions.torn_write: close the attempt rather than repeat a call; implemented with a write-ahead call_started entry; torn scored/completed are re-derived (refinement flagged for review)

scope: R7 run-lifecycle architecture (journal/replay) only; the scientific design is unchanged
